==Assassin Tomb==
;Paying Respects
:''This is a [[../Uplay/]]-only map.''
This isn't much of a "tomb" as it does not reward you with a seal like the others. Instead, it is a series of timed platforming puzzles intercut with plaques detailing the history of Ezio's great-great-grandfather. At the end are three chests holding ~500 florins each and two sarcophagi presumably holding Ezio's ancestors' remains.

==Glyph==
*There is only one glyph in Monteriggioni, located on the top-right corner of the villa's front wall. It looks like a barcode with the number "12212012" below it.

==Statuettes==
There are eight statuettes hidden around Monteriggioni, each depicting a Roman god. There are four sets of two statuettes, and completing a set on the pedestals behind the villa will reward Ezio with 2000 florins. This means that collecting all eight statuettes will earn you a handsome reward of 8000 florins, excellent starting capital for the village restoration.
*'''Mars''': Located on a wall in the southwest corner of the villa's front yard.
*'''Venus''': Located northwest of the Mars statuette's location, above a scaffolding between a building and the village wall.
*'''Pluto''': Located opposite the Mars statuette, in the southeast corner of the yard.
*'''Neptune''': Located near a tree behind the blacksmith.
*'''Jupiter''': Located on the back wall of the church, above the window.
*'''Minerva''': Located on the roof behind the art shop.
*'''Diana''': Located under a window behind the doctor's stall.
*'''Apollo''': Located on a roof north of the brothel, in the southwestern corner of the village.

==Viewpoints==
*There is only one viewpoint in Monteriggioni, located on top of the villa. It reveals everything in and around the village.

==Feathers==
*'''Total''': 4
